public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Respect wrapped-label height in the minimum bar band**

When labels need more space than `min_band` but still fit within the nominal `band`, this condition ignores their height when computing the minimum. With the test profile, a label of `"word " * 40` occupies three lines and requires a 44 px band, but ten such bars receive `min_units=51`, allowing only 26 px per bar after the frame and axes. Consequently, `problem(51)` reports no issue even though the labels overlap. Compute the minimum from the required label height independently of whether it exceeds the nominal band.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Keep HTML breaks inside their heading block** When a heading contains `
`, replacing the tag with a source newline terminates the heading during block parsing, so subsequent text is measured using the paragraph style. For example, `# one
two
three` produces an `h1` followed by a paragraph; with the test profile this measures 150 px instead of 182 px for three heading lines, recommending a height that clips the content. Preserve the inline break within its original block rather than turning it into a block-parsing boundary. Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

causal_evidence: O commit 57b2308b46368d3c1b97100ebe0df4f81088dd59 introduziu estimate_horizontal_bars com a expressão band if band > bars.band else bars.min_band, que ignorava a altura necessária quando ela não ultrapassava a banda nominal.
Executando o código desse commit em memória com o perfil dos testes e dez rótulos 'word ' * 40, reproduziu-se label_band_px=44, min_units=51 e problem(51)=None.
O diff do commit 94149cfae49f235bed5ede0b2969c99173faa8e1 substitui essa condição por max(bars.min_band, label_band_px(content.labels, profile)); a correção já está no HEAD.
evidences: supersetapiplus/dashboards/layout/sizing.py:331–340 calcula separadamente a altura necessária dos rótulos; a linha 360 a incorpora ao mínimo.
No HEAD 94149cfae49f235bed5ede0b2969c99173faa8e1, o exemplo exato da thread retorna min_units=74 e problem(51) informa altura abaixo do mínimo.
tests/unit/test_layout_sizing.py:205–209 cobre rótulos que exigem 32 px, entre min_band=26 e band=44.
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -s -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit/test_layout_sizing.py -k 'horizontal_bars or minimum_bar_band': 2 passed, 34 deselected.
payload.headline: Achado procedente, já corrigido no HEAD
payload.before: Dez barras com rótulos de três linhas recebiam mínimo de 51 unidades, apesar de exigirem uma banda de 44 px.
payload.after: O mínimo considera a altura dos rótulos independentemente da banda nominal; o mesmo exemplo exige 74 unidades e rejeita 51.
payload.motivation: Evitar que uma altura considerada válida comprima os rótulos e provoque sobreposição.
payload.reply: Confirmed in the original implementation and already fixed by 94149cfae49f235bed5ede0b2969c99173faa8e1. The minimum now uses the required label height independently of the nominal band. Your exact example returns min_units=74 and flags problem(51). Both relevant bar-sizing tests pass; no further code change is needed.
payload.ca_dod_impact: Restaura o contrato de que min_units respeita o espaço necessário para os rótulos das barras.
